published.source: Warrior re-optimization at flat Rage, 2026-10-25 (standards 21, k flat at the level 30 value): the rotation and talent searches moved Berserker Rage under 30 Rage (never), Heroic Strike from 90 (85; the duty already 90), Slam from 45 (30), Improved Berserker Rage 2/2 for a point of Enrage. Orc stays (race sweep on both seed sets). 20k iterations, 180s, seed 1 (was 1033.7 at ×1.5 Rage, 958.4 at flat Rage before the re-search)

rotation: Start with no Rage; before the pull Battle Stance, Charge for 15 Rage and back to Berserker Stance; Battle Shout from the raid
Sunder Armor as the first GCD after the pull (every warrior; the tanks keep it up after)
Death Wish held for the last 36s, Recklessness for the last 30s
Blood Fury and Berserking held for the last 30s, Elune's Light with Death Wish; Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20s
Bloodrage under 20 Rage, Berserker Rage under 30 (Improved Berserker Rage)
Bloodthirst, then Slam from 45 Rage right after a main hand swing, then Whirlwind at 25+ Rage
Execute in the execute phase, after Bloodthirst and Whirlwind (Execute first loses 4.7 on Fury and 22.7 on two-hand Fury)
Heroic Strike queued from 90 Rage (outside execute)
caveats: The on-use trinket's last use is held for the final 34s.
White hit Rage scales with weapon speed, the level 30 rate at every level (user ruling 2026-10-25; it was ×1.5 at 60).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is white hits only, and Heroic Strike counts for Unbridled Wrath.
One +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 12.0.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece not counted. It would add 8.8 vs Humanoids.
Holding Death Wish for 36s: +17.4 at 180s, +28.4 at 120s.
Raid damage hits (2 a minute, about 9 Rage each) are an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec fury -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_arms -apl level60_fury_2h -talents 30305013032-25053000142210501 -race Orc -duration 180, unedited (mksettings sets the raid hits, 2 a minute at 1500). Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts. Uses the Fury class options (Berserker Stance) as the preset build does; the preset's DefaultConsumes keep an off-hand stone, which has no effect without an off hand.
